name: rotatile
description: Rotate any block by a free angle from the editor sidebar. Server-rendered CSS transform, no JavaScript on the front end.

scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . languages/rotatile.pot --slug=rotatile --domain=rotatile --package-name="Rotatile" --exclude=vendor,node_modules,build,dist,docs,tests,.github && wp i18n update-po languages/rotatile.pot languages/rotatile-fr_FR.po && wp i18n make-mo languages/ && wp i18n make-json languages/ --no-purge --pretty-print --use-map='{"src/editor.js":"build/editor.js"}'
